sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Three small tree-spirits watch from the grove, leaf hair trembling, bark hands half-raised, roots curled around stones like they are guarding a line.

sections.title: Public role
sections.body: Sablewood justice response to abused hospitality

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: Small sapling spirits with bark-textured limbs, leaf hair, green-gold eyes, and shy defensive postures rooted around stones like children guarding a boundary.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use as forest-justice pressure and a chance for players to slow down, speak gently, and prove they can be guests instead of claimants.
